description: Canonical event-level schema for the LLM-generated ecommerce benchmark.

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Session identifier used to join event rows to session-level ground truth.

columns.name: anon_user_id
columns.description: Synthetic anonymous user identifier.

columns.name: site_id
columns.description: Dashboard site identifier.

columns.name: request_id
columns.description: Batch/request correlation id compatible with the collector payload.

columns.name: schema_version
columns.description: Collector schema version. Default 1.

columns.name: app_id
columns.description: Synthetic generator application id.

columns.name: ts
columns.description: Client event timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

columns.name: received_at
columns.description: Collector receive timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

columns.name: event_name
columns.description: Raw event type such as page_view, click, search, add_to_cart, checkout_start, payment_attempt, checkout_complete.

columns.name: url
columns.description: Absolute page URL.

columns.name: path
columns.description: Path-only page identifier used by session analytics.

columns.name: referrer
columns.description: Previous page or traffic source landing reference.

columns.name: user_agent
columns.description: Synthetic browser user-agent string.

columns.name: lang
columns.description: Browser language, usually ko-KR.

columns.name: screen
columns.description: Synthetic device screen size.

columns.name: viewport
columns.description: Synthetic browser viewport size.

columns.name: ui_variant
columns.description: Assigned UI variant when synthetic AB assignment is used.

columns.name: experiments
columns.description: Collector-compatible experiment assignments.

columns.name: props
columns.description: Event-specific payload. Stored as nested JSON/object in parquet.

columns.name: device
columns.description: Context variable such as mobile or desktop. Not a ground-truth label.

columns.name: traffic_source
columns.description: Context variable such as search_engine, direct, ad, social, email.

columns.name: source_type
columns.description: Data provenance marker. Must be synthetic for this benchmark.

columns.name: generator_version
columns.description: Synthetic generator version used to create the row.
